cards.title: Exact compatible heat certificate, scalar obstruction and critical storage
cards.scientific_scope: Internally proved all-background QC for the particular G; full invariant ROC cone open. Nonpolyconvexity, closed positive-module exclusion, sharp general-class elimination and non-strict critical storage are scoped analytic results.
cards.statement: G=3(u+v−2j)^2+(35/24)u^2+j^2−(5/2)ju is QC on bounded planar Lipschitz domains for W0^{1,4} tests at every B, by an exact rational compatible heat identity. The prior lifted-minor law proves G nonpolyconvex. Full soft action D≥0 and T²≤(8748/5)PD. G reduced scalar value is nevertheless nonconvex at an actual unique scalar minimizer with elliptic scalar blocks. Non-strict QC gives finite strong-continuous W^{3/4,4} required supply; current heat primitive depends on unspecified normal jets. General ROC quartic translated minimizers converge sharply at R^{-1/3}, energy at R^{-4/3}, with exact-mass multiplier correction.
assumptions: The exact specific polynomial, rational Gram/closed-form orderings and anisotropic heat coefficients are fixed; G theorem is planar2×2, quartic growth and all affine B.
Compatible Sobolev gradients, strong W1,4 density and Dirichlet/periodic passage; W4 law limits require uniform fourth-tail integrability, not merely a finite limiting fourth moment.
Sharp translation theorem allows general quartics with μ1>0, affine boundary and its stated mass convention; sharpness not proved in left-SO(2) subclass.
Critical storage uses moving means and arbitrary finite strip widths; strong trace topology, paid extension-tail modulus; pointwise Lipschitz only around fixed W1,4 base.
proof_spine: Exact rational LDL and universal Hessian/closed-two-form identity imply monotone heat energy and all-B Jensen.
Old four-atom lifted law violates convex Jensen; exposed acoustic null face excludes the specified complete positive-module cone.
Complete compatible perturbation polynomial yields soft discriminant including zero cases; exact finite scalar-minimizer trial refutes reduced convexity without refuting QC.
Quartic monotonicity plus translation C1 residual yields sharp development and weak stress envelope.
Close incoming strips with fixed return to bound storage; folded short connectors give continuity; actual heat circulation tests disprove trace-only primitive shortcut.
cards.costs: Finite rational certificate verification has recorded dimensions; proof is universal, no numerical field oracle. Required-supply value is an infimum, not an acquired finite evaluation algorithm; equilibrated residual requires supplied/constructed flux.
cards.information_acquisition: Exact JSON acquired by discovery search and independently reconstructed; old nonpoly witness credited. Heat proof supplies sign; normal boundary jets, uniform rough-ball modulus and computable storage remain unsupplied.
cards.obstruction: G−ε|A|4 is not ROC for any ε>0; full cone, evaluable nonlocal storage and external review remain open. Scalar Euler/positive scalar blocks and inherited positive orbit modules cannot supply the requested general convexity/QC shortcut.
cards.comparator: Existing isotropic/right-input/Fstar/polyconvex cones and strict FR storage; general variational and heat machinery. New G representation goes beyond the specified inherited positive cone, without priority claim.
cards.missing_lemma: No missing lemma for the internally proved specific-G conclusion; general cone certificate and an evaluable critical-trace calibration remain missing.
cards.next_decisive_step: Independently review exact heat/analytic scope and nearest prior art; then test a new normalized extreme ROC ray with rational compatible-heat feasibility or a genuine compatible negative field, and construct certified profile-only storage bounds.
cards.read_review_depth: Root reconstructed load-bearing analytic arguments and exact identities; complementary workers constructed/reviewed isolated approaches, then compared results. Same-team review, exact polynomial proof, bounded fixtures and primary experimental evidence retain distinct scopes. External correctness, formal verification and priority UNKNOWN.
